name: W5000 - Endpoint App Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Endpoint App launch into the Unauthorized endpoint-apps surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before opening or interacting with non-sanctioned apps (P2P, FTP/remote, unauthorized browsers, IT admin tooling outside IT staff). Exclusions: gated by the [CH]-curated category lists and Endpoint_Apps_Unauthorized_[is]; tune the customer-extension Unauthorized list with org-specific prohibited apps so warns hit the right surface.
